BrochureContent.Content:
Hunters Estate Agent is delighted to present this exceptional seafront apartment located in the prestigious Bartra Rock development. Occupying an enviable coastal setting, this elegant two-bedroom residence is presented in immaculate, walk-in condition and offers generously proportioned accommodation with breathtaking views across Dublin Bay towards Howth Head. One of only three apartments within this exclusive two-storey block, it provides an outstanding sense of privacy, tranquillity, and exclusivity.

Designed with both comfort and style in mind, the apartment boasts beautifully appointed interiors and a superb private balcony overlooking the impeccably maintained communal gardens—an idyllic space to relax and simply enjoy the sea air throughout the warmer months.

Flooded with natural light thanks to its dual-aspect design, the accommodation begins with a spacious entrance hall leading to a generously sized living and dining room. This impressive reception space features a striking fireplace, dual-aspect windows, and direct access to the balcony, creating a seamless connection between the indoor and outdoor living areas. The living room flows effortlessly into a contemporary, fully fitted kitchen complete with an attractive breakfast peninsula, ideal for casual dining.

There are two spacious double bedrooms, both with built-in wardrobes, including a superb principal bedroom with en-suite facilities. A stylish guest bathroom and a generous walk-in cloak cupboard complete the accommodation.

Bartra Rock is accessed via a secure electric gated entrance from Bullock Harbour, offering residents a peaceful and exclusive environment. The beautifully landscaped communal grounds are meticulously maintained, with ample resident parking and spectacular sea views towards Dalkey Island from every aspect.

Perfectly positioned in one of Dublin's most desirable coastal locations, Bartra Rock offers the best of seaside living while remaining exceptionally well connected. Residents can enjoy scenic coastal walks, easy access to the charming villages of Sandycove, Glasthule, and Dalkey, along with excellent transport links providing swift access to Dublin city centre.

Viewing is highly recommended.
